{{Quote|The m'Yalfor'ac Order is a native military force of the planet Guiteica, home of the Bitthævrian species.|Special unit threat assessment report by New Republic Captain Zgorth'sth|<ref name="Journal15">{{JournalCite|15|Special Military Unit Intelligence Update}}</ref>}}
'''Kadok III-D''', commonly known as '''Guiteica''', was a harsh [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space's]] [[Kadok Regions/Legends|Kadok Regions]]. It featured [[Forest/Legends|forests]], [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]], [[Water/Legends|glaciers]], and huge waterfalls. The planet possessed rich reserves of metal [[Ore/Legends|ores]] and [[Mineral/Legends|minerals]] such as [[feldspar]], [[yttrium]], and [[Bal'ta'ran crystal]]s. Guiteica was inhabited by creatures such as [[j'kuutak]] and [[Roggwart/Legends|roggwart]]. It was also the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Bitthævrian/Legends|Bitthævrians]], a warlike yet isolationist [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The sixteen primary continents of Guiteica were each governed by a separate military force, which made up the [[Planetary Security Forces|planetary defense force]] known as the [[Guiteica Militia]]. The dominant [[Army/Legends|army]] on Guiteica was the [[m'Yalfor'ac Order]] of the [[l'Quar'ta]] continent.

The Bitthævrian [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] [[Quaal Tavier Catharius]] eventually rose to the leadership of the m'Yalfor'ac Order at a [[Time/Legends|time]] of strained relations between Guiteica and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The physically imposing [[Escape of Aul Tarrus Vishav|formerly]] [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] Bitthævrian [[Aul Tarrus Vishav]] also joined the Order, becoming one of Tavier's [[Guardian (rank)|elite bodyguards]]. During a period of Bitthævrian expansion around [[65 BBY/Legends|65 BBY]], the Republic secretly backed an unsuccessful [[Coup against Quaal Tavier Catharius|coup]] against Tavier by [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Jael Ganton Farvash]]. After Ganton was sentenced to [[Death/Legends|execution]] for an [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] attempt against Tavier, the former challenged the latter to a duel in a traditional m'Yalfor'ac Order battle arena. Although Ganton attempted to cheat during the subsequent [[Battle at the m'Yalfor'ac Order battle arena|confrontation]], he was bested by the combined efforts of Tarrus and the wounded Tavier, with the incident helping to cement both of their reputations as Bitthævrian heroes.

Following the unsuccessful coup, the Republic attempted to cover its involvement by tricking the [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] of the nearby planet [[Kalee/Legends|Kalee]] into thinking the Bitthævrians presented a threat to their homeworld. The Republic trained and outfitted the Kaleesh [[kolkpravis]] army, which, aided by a group of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]], successfully [[Bitthævrian War|drove back]] the Bitthævrian advance, in the process [[Invasion of Guiteica|invading]] Guiteica. As a result of the conflict, the m'Yalfor'ac Order declared eternal enmity toward the Republic and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. When the Republic [[Declaration of a New Order|gave way]] to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] was [[Declaration of Rebellion/Legends|formed]], the m'Yalfor'ac Order came to view the Alliance as its new enemy due to it attempting to restore the Republic. The Order, however, was also hostile to the Empire, repulsing the attempts of [[Mining/Legends|mining]] companies to gain access to Guiteica's resources and attacking Imperial [[Patrol ship/Legends|patrol craft]]. Ultimately, the Empire did not pursue any further actions against Guiteica, and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] subsequently largely ignored the planet, as well.

==Description==
{{Quote|The only reason to venture to the tertiary ''[sic]'' at all was for Guiteica's mineral deposits, notably the rich veins of Bal'ta'ran crystals.|Special unit threat assessment report by New Republic Captain Zgorth'sth|<ref name="Journal15" />}}
[[File:Roggwart-SWCT.png|thumb|right|300px|Roggwarts, including Gor, were native to Guiteica.]]
Guiteica was the common name of Kadok III-D, a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Tertiary Kadok system]],<ref name="AIR" /> a part of the [[Kadok Regions/Legends|Kadok Regions]] of [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It occupied the fourth [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position around its [[Star/Legends|star]], [[Kadok III]], and was itself orbited by nine [[Moon/Legends|moons]]. A [[Standard day/Legends|day]] on Guiteica lasted 27 [[Standard hour/Legends|standard hours]], and 306 [[Local day/Legends|local days]] made up the [[local year]], which also consisted of seven seasons: [[Giil]], [[Quul]], [[Aul]], [[Zoul]], [[Tweil]], [[Jael]], and [[Quaal]].<ref name="AIR" />

Possessing standard [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] and a breathable Type I [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], Guiteica was a harsh, terrestrial world with a [[Temperature/Legends|temperate]] climate. The planet's surface featured sixteen primary continents and a dry [[Hydrosphere/Legends|hydrosphere]]. Guiteica's terrain forms included [[Forest/Legends|forests]], [[Water/Legends|glaciers]], desolate [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]] with soaring peaks, and immense waterfalls.<ref name="AIR" />

The planet also had substantial [[Mineral/Legends|mineral]] resources, chief among which were<ref name="AIR" /> rich veins of [[Bal'ta'ran crystal]]s<ref name="Journal15" /> and extensive subterranean deposits of [[feldspar]] and [[yttrium]]. Although many [[Species/Legends|species]] that were less hardy than Guiteica's native [[Bitthævrian/Legends|Bitthævrians]] considered the planet to be overly rugged, its natural beauty was rich and featured gorgeous vistas. Guiteica was home to the creatures known as [[j'kuutak]]<ref name="AIR" /> and [[Roggwart/Legends|roggwart]].<ref name="EpGuide" /> [[Xenobiologist/Legends|Xenobiologists]] differed in their opinion on whether roggwarts were an offshoot of the Bitthævrians or merely were visually similar due to convergent evolution, with an additional possibility being that the latter created the former through [[Bioengineering/Legends|genetic engineering]].<ref name="Season1">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars – The Official Episode Guide: Season 1]]''</ref>

==History==
===The m'Yalfor'ac Order===
====Rise of Quaal Tavier Catharius====
{{Quote|Colonel Tavier is the 31st leader of the m'Yalfor'ac Order, and like his predecessors, gained his position through meritorious action in combat against Republic-allied troops, guerrilla operations against pro-Republic corporate complexes, and exceptional leadership.|Task Force on Alliance Security SecuriDex datafile on the m'Yalfor'ac Order|<ref name="AIR" />}}
The Bitthævrians entered a period of expansion in the Kadok Regions during the reign of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="GaW">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref> The natural predisposition of certain Republic member species,<ref name="Journal15" /> such as the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]], toward deceptive scheming and [[Politics/Legends|political]] manipulation, as opposed to direct conflict, was anathema to the warlike Bitthævrians,<ref name="AIR" /> and for [[Standard year/Legends|years]], the relations between the Republic and the species were strained.<ref name="Lord of War">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/86/indexp2.html|text=The Story of General Grievous: Lord of War|int=The Story of General Grievous: Lord of War}}</ref>

During that [[Time/Legends|time]], [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Quaal Tavier Catharius]] rose to the position of the thirty-first leader of the [[m'Yalfor'ac Order]], the dominant Bitthævrian continental [[Army/Legends|army]], through meritorious action in combat against [[Trooper/Legends|troops]] allied with the Republic and [[Guerrilla warfare/Legends|guerrilla operations]] against Republic-affiliated corporate complexes. Tavier's leadership let him attain the status of a hero with his people.<ref name="AIR" />

====From enslaved to bodyguard====
{{Quote|<nowiki />''[Tarrus]'' was perceived as a threat by the slave masters because of his great size and unbelievable strength. ''[&hellip;]'' he was bound and imprisoned in one of the small chambers located at the foothills of the u'Tal'ac Range. ''[&hellip;]'' Vishav eventually broke his bonds: the carnage that he left behind in his escape is legendary among the slaves of the Bal'ta'ran mines.|Task Force on Alliance Security SecuriDex datafile on the m'Yalfor'ac Order|<ref name="AIR" />}}
At some point during the many wars fought by the m'Yalfor'ac Order, [[Aul Tarrus Vishav]], an [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] Bitthævrian in the [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] [[Mining/Legends|mines]] of the [[Upper Bal'ta'ran Cluster]] of islands on Guiteica, was sentenced to be [[Death/Legends|executed]] by his [[Slaver/Legends|enslavers]], who felt intimidated by Tarrus' great size and strength. Tarrus was bound with [[Binders/Legends|manacles]] and [[Prisoner/Legends|imprisoned]] in one of the chambers of the [[u'Tal'ac Range]].<ref name="AIR" />

When Tarrus eventually [[Escape of Aul Tarrus Vishav|escaped]] his [[Prison/Legends|imprisonment]], the carnage he left behind gained legendary status among the other enslaved beings of the Upper Bal'ta'ran Cluster mines. Tarrus eventually joined the m'Yalfor'ac Order and gained the rank of [[Guardian (rank)|Guardian]], one of the few elite [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]] protecting Quaal Tavier Catharius.<ref name="AIR" />

===Conflict with the Republic===
====Coup attempt====
{{Quote|Colonel Quaal Tavier Catharius is an imposing and memorable figure. ''[&hellip;]'' He suffered permanent injuries in battle against Major Jael Ganton Farvash, who sought to assassinate him. However, his besting of this rival accorded him a place in the Bitthævrian history books. He is regarded as one of the greatest leaders in Guiteica's history.|Task Force on Alliance Security SecuriDex datafile on the m'Yalfor'ac Order|<ref name="AIR" />}}
[[File:MYalforacOrder-AIR.png|thumb|left|300px|Quaal Tavier Catharius (second rightmost) and Aul Tarrus Vishav (rightmost) averted a coup attempt on Guiteica.]]
Around [[65 BBY/Legends|65 BBY]],<ref name="GaW" /> the Republic secretly backed<ref name="Lord of War" /> Bitthævrian [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Jael Ganton Farvash]],<ref name="AIR" /> who attempted a [[Coup against Quaal Tavier Catharius|coup]] against Tavier with the intention to declare total allegiance of Guiteica to the Republic.<ref name="Lord of War" /> Ganton unsuccessfully attempted to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] Tavier, seriously injuring the colonel in the process. When Ganton was subsequently sentenced to be executed, he challenged Tavier to a [[Battle at the m'Yalfor'ac Order battle arena|duel]], which the injured leader was forced to accept per Bitthævrian tradition.<ref name="AIR" />

The duel of Tavier and Ganton was held at a m'Yalfor'ac Order battle arena and was presided over by a [[Succession Judge|judge]] who secretly favored Ganton's bid for power. Breaking the traditional rules of the duel, Ganton attempted to have his Guardians intervene to tip the outcome of the battle to his favor; however, he was ultimately slain by Tavier after Tarrus killed all of the would-be usurper's bodyguards. Following the battle, Tarrus became a Bitthævrian hero and Tavier reached the status of one of the greatest military leaders of Guiteica's history.<ref name="AIR" />

====Enter the Kaleesh====
{{Quote|Two generations ago, this ''[Bitthævrian cultural traits]'' led to a military confrontation between the Order and the Old Republic.|Special unit threat assessment report by New Republic Captain Zgorth'sth|<ref name="Journal15" />}}
[[File:KaleeshKolkpravisWarriors-GAW.jpg|thumb|right|290px|Members of the Kaleesh species fought the Bitthævrians and invaded Guiteica.]]
Another effect of<ref name="Lord of War" /> Ganton's<ref name="AIR" /> unsuccessful coup was a Bitthævrian rebellion against all representation of the Republic in the Kadok Regions. Intending to keep their involvement in the incident secret, corrupt Republic officials tricked the [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] natives of [[Kalee/Legends|Kalee]], a planet adjacent to the Kadok Regions, into believing their world was in danger of conquest by the Bitthævrians. Republic agents secretly trained<ref name="Lord of War" /> the [[kolkpravis]] army of Kaleesh as an insurgent force, arming it with [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka]] [[Outland rifle/Legends|Outland rifles]].<ref name="GaW" /> In addition, a contingent of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]],<ref name="Lord of War" /> including [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|apprentice]], [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]],<ref name="GaW" /> was sent to fight the Bitthævrian advance alongside the Kaleesh, which included the [[Grievous's great-grandmother|great-grandmother]] of the future [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]]<ref name="Lord of War" /> [[Grievous/Legends|Qymaen jai Sheelal]].<ref name="GaW" />

During the ensuing [[Bitthævrian War|conflict]],<ref name="GaW" /> Guiteica was [[Invasion of Guiteica|invaded]], and many Kaleesh warlords took baby roggwarts from the planet as trophies.<ref name="EpGuide" /> Among those roggwarts was [[Gor/Legends|Gor]], which, during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]<ref name="TCWCharEncylopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref> of [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]&ndash;[[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> was kept by Sheelal, known as [[General/Legends|General]] Grievous by that time, as a pet and guardian at [[Grievous's castle/Legends|his castle]] on<ref name="TCWCharEncylopedia" /> the [[Third moon of Vassek/Legends|third moon of Vassek]].<ref name="Vassek">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode010.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Lair of Grievous}}</ref>

====Against the Republic and the Empire====
{{Quote|This short war was settled by the efforts of a band of Jedi, who used their powers to the Republic's advantage. The Republic and Jedi were therefore condemned by the Order and declared perpetual enemies of the Bitthævrian people.|Special unit threat assessment report by New Republic Captain Zgorth'sth|<ref name="Journal15" />}}
Within [[60 BBY/Legends|five years]] of the beginning of the Bitthævrian&ndash;Kaleesh conflict, the former withdrew in defeat.<ref name="GaW" /> As a result, the m'Yalfor'ac Order condemned the Republic and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and declared them both to be perpetual enemies of the Bitthævrian species. The Republic, however, subsequently ignored Guiteica due to the Bitthævrians rarely venturing off-world and only being equipped with outdated military technology.<ref name="Journal15" /> During the Clone Wars, Guiteica was situated outside the borders of the Republic.<ref name="TEA Kadok" />

Following the [[Declaration of a New Order|supplantation]] of the Republic by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]<ref name="AIR" /> in 19 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> many mining corporations, both private and those sanctioned by the Empire, attempted to negotiate mining rights on Guiteica with the Bitthævrians, only to be repulsed by the m'Yalfor'ac Order each time. On one occasion, when [[Vulca Minerals]] attempted to aggressively negotiate the rights to mine yttrium, the Order almost killed the company's [[Team Commander]]. Since the incident, all of Guiteica's exports were managed by the company [[Kadok Resources]].<ref name="AIR" />

===Hating the Alliance===
====Galactic Civil War====
{{Quote|Even though the Order condemned the Empire was immoral, Guiteica wasn't thought to be worth the effort of pacifying, especially when the Order publicly rebuffed Alliance efforts at recruitment.|Special unit threat assessment report by New Republic Captain Zgorth'sth|<ref name="Journal15" />}}
[[File:MYalforacOrderVehicles-AIR.png|thumb|left|295px|The military equipment of Guiteica's m'Yalfor'ac Order around 2 ABY]]
The m'Yalfor'ac Order eventually transferred its hatred for the Galactic Republic to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], which sought to restore the Republic, and in an Alliance [[Task Force on Alliance Security]] [[SecuriDex]] [[Datafile/Legends|datafile]] on the Order, [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Ayla Shar]] recommended the Alliance avoid Guiteica and its surrounding [[Realspace/Legends|space]] entirely, viewing the establishment of any [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomatic]] relations with the Bitthævrians as impossible.<ref name="AIR" />

Despite the hatred the m'Yalfor'ac Order held for the Rebel Alliance,<ref name="AIR" /> it also condemned the Galactic Empire as an immoral government,<ref name="Journal15" /> and Imperial [[Patrol ship/Legends|patrol craft]] that occasionally entered Bitthævrian space were attacked. Such actions strained the relations between the Empire and Guiteica,<ref name="AIR" /> although ultimately Guiteica was not deemed to be worth the effort of pacifying operations. Nevertheless, the mere fact that the Bitthævrians were resisting the Empire would have eventually led to the Imperial conquest of their homeworld, but such an event never came to pass due to the preoccupation of the Empire with its [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|conflict]] against the Rebel Alliance.<ref name="Journal15" />

Several years prior to<ref name="AIR" /> [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'' represents a collection of [[in-universe]] reports from "one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]," which corresponds to [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> members of the m'Yalfor'ac Order performed a raid on an off-world [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. The raid marked one of the few instances when the Order traveled off Guiteica and resulted in the army confiscating approximately three dozen [[All Terrain Personal Transport/Legends|All Terrain Personal Transport]] [[Walker/Legends|walkers]] from the pirates.<ref name="AIR" />

====New Republic====
{{Quote|The New Republic has no vital interests on Guiteica and can buy Bal'ta'ran crystals on the market. A ban or heavy tariff on military hardware intended for Guiteica may be desirable to keep them from gaining enough military equipment to create an appetite for conquest.|Special unit threat assessment report by New Republic Captain Zgorth'sth|<ref name="Journal15" />}}
[[File:Guiteica-TEA.png|thumb|right|300px|Guiteica lay outside the territory of the Pentastar Alignment and the Imperial Remnant.]]
Guiteica fell outside the territory controlled by the [[Pentastar Alignment]] between [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] and [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]].<ref name="TEA Kadok" /> Following the [[Declaration of a New Republic/Legends|establishment]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the m'Yalfor'ac Order publicly criticized the new incarnation of its hated Republic. The Order also claimed control over a large territory of space outside Guiteica's [[Star system/Legends|system]], although it possessed neither [[Colonist/Legends|colonies]] nor outposts to support its claim.<ref name="Journal15" />

At some point years prior to the [[Great ReSynchronization|date]] [[9 ABY/Legends|44:9:4:85]], the [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]] [[Collector/Legends|collector]] known as "[[Credman]]" visited Guiteica. "Credman" stayed on the planet for several years, in the process learning the materials used in the construction of the Bitthævrian traditional [[dematoil]] weapon and fashioning a simple version of the dematoil.<ref name="Gundark">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>

Following the [[Battle of Onderon (Galactic Civil War)|final defeat]] of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]<ref name="Journal15" /> in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]],<ref name="NEC" /> New Republic [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Zgorth'sth]] compiled available information on the m'Yalfor'ac Order as part of a threat assessment report focusing on various special units. In the report, Zgorth'sth stated that the New Republic did not have any vital interests on Guiteica and noted the potential necessity for a ban or a heavy tariff on military technology to be [[Merchant/Legends|sold]] to Guiteica in order to keep the military ambitions of the Order in check.<ref name="Journal15" /> Between [[18 ABY/Legends|18 ABY]] and [[35 ABY/Legends|35 ABY]], Guiteica lay outside the borders of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]].<ref name="TEA Kadok" />

==Inhabitants==
===The native sentients===
{{Main|Bitthævrian/Legends}}
{{Quote|Bitthævrians are naturally and culturally inclined to use direct conflict to resolve disputes. This has led to a warrior ethos and intense dislike of aliens who use diplomacy, political process or indirect methods.|Special unit threat assessment report by New Republic Captain Zgorth'sth|<ref name="Journal15" />}}
Guiteica was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the Bitthævrians, an ancient [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] species. The skin of many Bitthævrian races originating in Guiteica's northern regions was [[Color/Legends|black]] or dark brown in color&mdash;as opposed to the rust-colored brown or ruddy yellow pigmentation common to the majority of the Bitthævrians&mdash;and some groups of the natives from the planet's equatorial areas had light tan skin.<ref name="AIR" />

The Bitthævrians were a warlike people, and their society held personal combat in high regard. In addition, the species had a low opinion of the rest of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and as a result, the natives of Guiteica became an isolated culture and almost never ventured off-world. Exceptions usually only occurred when a Bitthævrian was [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] down an individual who had either committed a crime or dishonored a Bitthævrian leader.<ref name="AIR" />

===Planetary society===
{{Quote|The planetary defense force which the m'Yalfor'ac Order officially belongs to is known simply as the Guiteica Militia.|Task Force on Alliance Security SecuriDex datafile on the m'Yalfor'ac Order|<ref name="AIR" />}}
Guiteican population numbered 7.8 million, and each of the planet's primary continents was governed by a separate military group, all of which were represented in Guiteica's [[Planetary Security Forces|planetary defense force]]. That force was known as the [[Guiteica Militia]] and was dominated by the army known as the m'Yalfor'ac Order.<ref name="AIR" />

The society on Guiteica had reached the space [[Technology level|level of technology]], and metal [[Ore/Legends|ores]] and minerals, including the Bal'ta'ran crystals, were exported off-world. In return, medicines and high technology, such as [[Computer/Legends|computers]] and starship components, were imported on a biannual basis.<ref name="AIR" /> Specifically, the m'Yalfor'ac Order traded the Bal'ta'ran crystals for second-hand military technology.<ref name="Journal15" /> All essential goods needed for the nutritional requirements of the Bitthævrians were procured on Guiteica itself.<ref name="AIR" />

==Locations==
{{Quote|The 16 different continents each contribute hardware and troops to the Militia for defense, but the m'Yalfor'ac Order is clearly recognized as the leader of the Militia, as the headquarters are based on the l'Quar'ta continent of the Order, ''[&hellip;]''<nowiki />|Task Force on Alliance Security SecuriDex datafile on the m'Yalfor'ac Order|<ref name="AIR" />}}
One of the primary continents of Guiteica was [[l'Quar'ta]], the northern portions of which featured steep mountain ranges. The headquarters of the Guiteica Militia were located on l'Quar'ta, and the m'Yalfor'ac Order was also based on the continent. One of the Order's sites was a traditional battle arena used for duels. Just off the northwest coast of l'Quar'ta lay the Upper Bal'ta'ran Cluster, a group of islands that featured crystal mines.<ref name="AIR" />

Other locations on Guiteica included a single [[Standard Class starport|standard-class spaceport]]; the u'Tal'ac Range, at the foothills of which was situated several small chambers; and [[s'Korth'an]], outside of which lay a series of hills that were sacred to the Bitthævrians. Bitthævrian Major [[Zoul Lavor Xariv Lar]] [[Burial/Legends|buried]] his best friend and long-time rival, Major [[Quaal Stavi Giniras]], in the hills outside s'Korth'an following the latter's death of old age.<ref name="AIR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Guiteica was first mentioned in ''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'', a [[1995]] sourcebook for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="AIR" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which misspelled the planet's name as "Guiteca" on one occasion, placed the Tertiary Kadok system, and therefore Guiteica, in grid square J-4.<ref name="TEA Kadok" />

The [[September]] 2009<ref name="Wizards">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/GalaxyatWarrpg|text=''Galaxy at War''}}</ref> [[Wizards of the Coast]] sourcebook ''[[Galaxy at War]]'' states that roggwarts were native to<ref name="GaW" /> the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]<ref name="TEA Vendaxa">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Vendaxa system/Legends|Vendaxa system]]</ref> world<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> [[Vendaxa/Legends|Vendaxa]].<ref name="GaW" /> However, in [[October]] 2009,<ref name="Amazon">{{Amazon|url=dp/0448452472|text=The Official Episode Guide: Season 1 (Star Wars: The Clone Wars)}}</ref> ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars – The Official Episode Guide: Season 1]]'' instead designated Guiteica as the species' homeworld,<ref name="Season1" /> which has been repeated in subsequent sources.<ref name="EpGuide" /><ref name="TCWCharEncylopedia" />
